messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'dedpool-volt-helix' node 'nvidia-0' (us-west-2) reporting repeated ECC errors + thermal throttling. Impact: ~6/8 GPUs degraded; HelixLabs inference jobs experiencing retries and elevated latency. Auto-drain attempted. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedpool-gpu-failure>. Paging oncall.

alex.m: I'm taking point. @sre-oncall can you confirm you're on? I'll start the tenant impact assessment and coordinate fallback.

sre-oncall: On it. I've pulled the latest logs. dmesg showing repeated GPU ECC and sm errors, and the node is spiking temperature to 94C then throttling. Suspect hardware thermal issue or bad NVLink on that card.

priya.s: Noted. HelixLabs has a reserved capacity in this pool — we need to avoid total eviction. Initial plan: cordon + drain node, migrate active sessions to dedpool-volt-fallback, and enable hosted fallback for critical endpoints. Will coordinate with routing.

mike.ops: Started cordon: `kubectl cordon nvidia-0` — now draining noncritical pods. Running drain command for inference pods:
```
kubectl drain nvidia-0 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60 --force
```
Some long-running sessions are pinned (model cache pinned). We'll need to force-migrate model caches.

alex.m: Running cache migration via infra tool:
```
redwoodctl model-cache migrate --tenant HelixLabs --node nvidia-0 --target-pool dedpool-volt-fallback
```
If migrate fails, we will route traffic to hosted fallback for ~critical routes: `/v1/generate` and `/v1/chat/completions` for HelixLabs app.

infra-bot: Automated migrate job failed for 2 pinned caches: lock timeout. Suggest manually flushing prefix cache for those sessions or restarting workers on fallback. I've opened infra ticket #INFRA-8244.

priya.s: On customer impact: telemetry shows HelixLabs 99th percentile latency up ~3x and a spike in 5xxs to 18% over the last 8m for models pinned to that node. Critical jobs (billing reconciliation) are latency-sensitive.

csm_oliver: I pinged HelixLabs CSM. They're aware and want temporary higher throughput on fallback. Please mention expected ETA for restore so I can update them.

sre-oncall: Mitigations applied:
- Node cordoned and draining in progress
- Active inference traffic for HelixLabs partial-migrated to dedpool-volt-fallback
- Hosted fallback route enabled for HelixLabs critical routes (rate-limited)
- Reduced batch size and lowered max_workers on fallback models to reduce OOM risk

Current status: Degraded -> partial mitigation. Some sessions still failing due to pinned caches/volume mounts.

alex.m: For pinned caches, we'll do a rolling restart of the HelixLabs workers on fallback with `--no-cache` to force rebuilds. I'll throttle to 2 instances at a time.

mike.ops: Rolling restarts started. Logs show a worker failing to load model: `CUDA out of memory` on fallback instance 3. We're lowering max_sequence and enabling quantized variant for that tenant temporarily.

priya.s: Quantized variant switch issued for HelixLabs non-critical models: `variant: v1-int8` for lower GPU footprint.

sre-oncall: Cloud provider notes: one of the GPUs hit repeated ECC and then reported thermal cooldown alarm; provider scheduled host maintenance on the instance. This looks like hardware starting to fail, not just a transient. I've opened ticket with provider: CP-INC-99321. Provider suggests reprovisioning node and migrating workloads.

alex.m: Agreed. Action plan summary and owners:
- Immediate: Complete drain of nvidia-0 and finish migration to fallback (Owner: mike.ops)
- Short term: Keep hosted fallback enabled and monitor error rate (Owner: priya.s)
- Infra: Replace node with new instance and reprovision pool (Owner: infra-bot / cp ticket)
- Customer comms: CSM to notify HelixLabs of ETA ~60-90m and mitigation steps (Owner: csm_oliver)
- Postmortem owner: alex.m

mike.ops: Drain completed at ~+12m, but 3 pinned sessions required manual eviction. All active pods relocated; traffic now mostly on fallback/hosted. Error rate down to 4% and latency trending back toward normal.

csm_oliver: Sharing update to HelixLabs: "We've routed your critical traffic to fallback capacity and enabled hosted fallback for highest-priority endpoints. We're replacing the faulty node and expect full restore within 90 minutes. We'll follow up with a root cause and postmortem." They asked for a Slack invite to the incident channel, I've invited them to a private thread.

infra-bot: CP-INC-99321 accepted by provider. Scheduled host replace in 45 minutes. We can reprovision a fresh node and join it to dedpool-volt-helix. Creating replacement node now.

priya.s: Monitoring plan: watch 5xx count, token-cost spikes, queue depth. Creating temporary alert thresholds for HelixLabs: 5xx > 5% for 5m (pager), 99p latency > 2x baseline (pager). Also enabling extra tracing for HelixLabs routes.

sre-oncall: After replacement node joins, we'll do gradual rebalancing: add node as cordoned until caches warmed, then uncordon. Avoid draining everyone back at once.

alex.m: Good. Post-incident tasks (add to ticket INF-xxxx): follow up with provider logs, validate ECC counters, check thermal throttling history, decide on host replacement vs decommission. Also propose adding secondary hot standby pool for reserved tenants to minimize migration time.

mike.ops: Reprovision complete, new node joined pool at +38m. Starting cache warm-up with low concurrency. No immediate errors reported on the new node.

sre-oncall: Final status at +55m: HelixLabs error rate down to 1.2%, 99p latency near baseline. Hosted fallback still available for 60m for safety. Marking incident as mitigated and moving to monitoring. Will keep PSP open until 3h of stable telemetry.

csm_oliver: Customer confirmed that critical jobs are running and that they see reduced errors. They'll expect postmortem and timeline for permanent fix.

alex.m: Thanks team. I'll own the postmortem and schedule a short RCA meeting tomorrow. Assigning follow-ups:
- Postmortem writeup (alex.m)
- Provider escalation and replacement confirmation (infra-bot)
- Add standby pool runbook section and test playbook (priya.s)
- Customer follow-up and timeline (csm_oliver)

incident-bot: Incident mitigated -> status: MONITORED. Auto-reminder to oncall in 3h for final check.
